<thought>Analyzing the isotopic pattern: the M+1 peak is ~13 % of the base peak, consistent with the presence of multiple carbon atoms (≈12 C atoms). The M+2 peak is ~33 % of the base peak, matching the characteristic 35Cl/37Cl ratio (≈3:1), indicating chlorine. No other element shows a distinctive isotopic signature (e.g., bromine would give an M+2 ≈ 100 %). Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
